author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,

Finally I can announce that today is my Birthday and I'm now 15.

Well I want to thank some ppl of Avicus:
Howseh: Sadly I didn't knew you so well! I always had fear to msg you via skype, cuz you were a director, a god for me xD Well now I reget it. As you said you take a break I msged you and it turned int to a great conversation. I hope I'll get your new skype name <3
Peachy: You helped me to get my first prestige on Nebula.
TheTNTDude: You helped me aswell.
Cinammon: You are really a great friend <3
Stormz: Also a great friend and a nice leader of the SNS xD
Mango and Cupcake: It was nice to talk to you guys after my interview xD
Roman: You are always sooo helpful <3
99: I love the games with you on Nebula and CTH. It's always fun!
Holden: I just love ya <3
Luca: One time bro, everytime bro :D
izy: You are great! The CTH matches are nice.
Clownz: Stop acking xD And you are also a good builder.
Fluey: The interview was a nice. Finally I heard your "creepy" voice xD
Arach: Sorry for what I did earlier and you are a great builder, player and staff member.
Para: Oh god! I don't know what to say! If I had to describe you in one word: AWESOME!
Evo: Your maps are great! you skins are great! Everything of you is just great!
Ivi: You are a great friend and btw you are 22 xD
Nolan: Always nice and helpful. And thank you for a ban appeal :D
Detty: It was really as you catched me in the nether portal (hub) xD
Sweeeper: Your building skillz are amazing! It was a honor to make the YAML :D
Atidt: You are the first one I met on Avicus who understands german.
X_Heat: One time Banana, always banana xD
Zedd: You are great. I love playing with you on the server <3
SliUnicorn: You are a unicorn and plz watch the cats ingame :D
sunny: Epic boat bow battle on the survival part of the one map.
Eric: Dun't call me nub, yu nub xD You are one of my best avi friends :D
DocterPop: I don't know you really much, but I enjoyed to listen to you on TS.
Sethskype: You are a good friend, you helped me on TS right before my interview with my mic and that was very important for me :D
Apricot: Maybe you'll not reading this, but you were a great staff member and a great friend, even if you beat me on every 1vs1 xD
Netox: I always remember you as a great friend and you helped me really much on stevens build server with Travincal/Arcade/TheLayers.

I'll add soo many ppl during the day, so if your name isn't on the list yet, then I just forgot you or I'm writing a sentence to you :D

And also Thank you to the ppl that are wished me a happy birthday <3
